author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam Savage visits the Academy's Margaret Herrick Library, home to over 2000 collections of film production ephemera and artwork spanning the entire history of Hollywood filmmaking. Today, he takes a look at rare material from the making of Blade Runner, including the progression of the Spinner's design from Syd Mead's sketches to art department blueprints!

Learn more about the Academy Museum and its collection at https://www.academymuseum.org/ and https://www.academycollection.org/
Learn more about the Academy Library at https://www.oscars.org/library
The Last Surviving Spaceship from 2001: A Space Odyssey: https://youtu.be/nDHNmhsTh0A
